question: What rejuvenating effect does six months of sustained practice produce even in the aged?
premises: The practice is performed for six months.
The practice is repeated and sustained.
Even an old person undergoes transformation.
inference: Through six months of sustained practice, even an old person becomes youthful.
uncertainties: The form 'taruṇā' may be read as an adverbial or nominal form in this context.
plain_english: Through six months of sustained practice, even an old person becomes youthful.
